measurements.memory_basis: maximum observed simultaneous sum of pipeline and verified descendant RSS; sampled, not lifetime; shared pages may be counted multiple times
measurements.cpu_basis: per-process user+system delta / monotonic sample interval; 100% equals one core; first observation is null
measurements.unobserved_children: Children born and exited between samples are not measured; disappearance has unknown exit code.

source.audio_hash_basis: recorded pipeline provenance; audio is not rehashed by monitor

artifacts.artifact_scope: full session files as read at monitor exit; may include time before attachment

cohorts.final_metric: speech_end_to_final_ms (estimated last VAD-positive frame end to server payload readiness)

final_source_coverage.basis: union of recorded half-open source sample intervals; excludes virtual padding
final_source_coverage.scope: caption windows, not all captured audio or all speech
final_source_coverage.interpretation: Gaps may be silence, hymn/music, pause, filtering, missed speech, or unfinished replay; source listening/annotations are required.

any_caption_source_coverage.basis: union of recorded half-open source sample intervals; excludes virtual padding
any_caption_source_coverage.scope: caption windows, not all captured audio or all speech
any_caption_source_coverage.interpretation: Gaps may be silence, hymn/music, pause, filtering, missed speech, or unfinished replay; source listening/annotations are required.

notes: Server update gaps include natural silence/music and loading; they are not all stalls.
No browser render ACK latency or speech/music ground truth is inferred.
Capture total/sample-loss coverage is unknown unless recorded separately in health.
Pipeline lifetime memory does not include native children; see sampled process-tree RSS separately.
